verdicts.reason: A is fragmented: the dark logo panel takes the top-left half with a tiny, nearly illegible SOLSTICE logo, the orange divider floats alone at top right, the CTA hangs in empty space, and the legal text spills across the centre under the CTA, so the headline is weak and the body copy is small. B reads left to right as a banner, with a dominant headline and the body copy, CTA and legal grouped in one column, but the dark logo block is an oversized, mostly empty slab, the eyebrow and divider are stranded under it, and the right column and CTA are jammed against the right edge with microscopic legal text.
